metadata.description: terse: writing rules and a context meter for Claude Code, by lowenbjer.

plugins.name: terse
plugins.description: Cuts Claude Code reply length in half and removes mannered prose. 22 writing rules as a forced output style, a per-turn reminder against drift in long sessions, the same rules for subagents, and a context meter for the status line. Measured on 20 prompts against a real codebase: Fable 5.1 46% fewer words and 51% lower cost, Opus 5.5 54% fewer words and 32% lower cost. Rules, method and numbers: github.com/lowenbjer/claude-terse
